flags.issue: Call observation dates are defined as 'each coupon observation date ... commencing January 2027' with no exclusion of the determination date, so the final date (July 9, 2029) is treated as callable -> 11 entries of 100 (obs 2..12). The interim-only exception of convention 5 does not appear to apply; economically a call on the final date (face + coupon if each index >= initial) coincides with the maturity payoff, so 10 vs 11 entries is price-neutral. Verify which count the gold convention expects.

Dates subject to postponement; January 11, 2027 and October 11, 2027 etc. are not on the 9th (business-day adjusted as filed). Read row by row from lines 151-162.
